segment_contamination_dimensions: Poultry and livestock buyers (poultry shed, cattle shed) — agricultural animal-housing buyers are a distinct segment from industrial/manufacturing buyers and are carved out by siblings Poultry Sheds (145222) and Cattle Sheds (146519); names or alt terms primarily signalling animal housing are excluded.

Portable and temporary shelter buyers (portable garage, folding garage, portable shelter) — buyers seeking relocatable or temporary personal/vehicle shelters are a distinct segment from industrial construction buyers; terms primarily signalling portability or personal-scale use are excluded.

Specialised non-industrial roofing buyers (auditorium roofing shed, badminton court roofing shed, swimming pool shed/tensile cover) — buyers procuring sport, leisure, or institutional roofing covers are a distinct segment; terms primarily signalling these end-uses are excluded.
Telecom and military shelter buyers — buyers procuring telecom equipment enclosures or defence-grade shelters are a distinct segment from industrial shed construction buyers; such terms are excluded.

Warehouse Sheds sibling (164769) carves out the pure warehousing sub-segment — the term 'warehouse shed' is retained in alt_names as a buyer search term but enhanced names do not lead with 'warehouse shed' as a standalone descriptor to avoid direct collision.
